subject: Quick ask: pilot feedback & placing a G2 review (reward options)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@stepstone.io>
Cc: Dana Lin <dana.lin@stepstone.io>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: pilot feedback & placing a G2 review (reward options)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for running the two-week inference pilot with us. Your team’s throughput data and the qualitative notes from Dana were super helpful for tuning the batching and cache settings. If you’re open to it, we’d love a short G2 review reflecting your experience (2–4 sentences is great).

Two quick asks:
- Would you be comfortable posting a brief G2 review summarizing the pilot? If yes, we can send a small thank-you (your choice of a $100 Amazon gift card or a $100 donation to a charity you choose).
- Can we also quote one line from your review in a customer snapshot / case blurb (we’ll send the quote for approval before publishing)?

I attached a one-pager with suggested language and a direct link to the G2 review form to make it quick: redwood-g2-instructions.pdf.

If you prefer, we can also schedule a 15-minute call to walk through the form — totally up to you.

Thanks, and no pressure — just appreciative of any feedback you’re willing to share.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-g2-instructions.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@stepstone.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Lin <dana.lin@stepstone.io>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: pilot feedback & placing a G2 review (reward options)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the note — happy to help. Dana and I discussed this morning and we can post a short G2 review. A couple of quick points:

- We prefer the $100 donation to the local STEM scholarship fund (you can email me the donation confirmation).
- If you have a one-line suggestion for a quote, send it over and I’ll confirm/edit before you publish.
- Can you confirm whether the public review should refer to the pilot duration or to a general evaluation? We’ll likely mention the two-week pilot.

Appreciate you making this simple.

—Alex
Alex Ramos
Head of Data Products | StepStone Financial
alex.ramos@stepstone.io | +1 212-555-0129

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: pilot feedback & placing a G2 review (reward options)

Team — forwarding Alex (StepStone) who agreed to post a short G2 review and requested a $100 donation instead of a gift card. Can ops handle the donation and send confirmation to Alex (alex.ramos@stepstone.io)?

Notes:
- Related deal: DEAL-2026-0571 (pilot completed 8/28).
- Alex asked whether the review should reference the two-week pilot — he said that’s fine.
- If we can also prepare one suggested 1-line quote for his approval, that would speed it up. Suggested quote (drafted below):

  "Redwood’s inference runtime cut our batch latency by ~30% during a short pilot, and the team was responsive to tuning requests."

Marissa — can you 1) generate a donation confirmation to the STEM scholarship fund (accounting help if needed), 2) drop the confirmation to alex.ramos and cc me and Stephanie, and 3) add a small public quote approval step to the follow-up email?

Ben — please save a record in HS-432109 with the review status once posted. Stephanie — loop in CS if you want to coordinate a short customer success note.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachment: giftcard-invoice-0571.pdf (stub for internal record)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick ask: pilot feedback & placing a G2 review (reward options)

Hi Alex —

Just circling back with an update: we completed the $100 donation to the "Bay Area STEM Scholars" on your behalf and attached the confirmation for your records. You should receive a separate email from donations@redwood.ai with the receipt.

We also put together a suggested one-line quote below to make posting quicker. Please feel free to edit — we won’t publish anything without your explicit sign-off:

  Suggested quote (editable): "During a two-week pilot, Redwood’s inference runtime reduced our average batch latency by ~30% and the team was responsive to tuning requests."

Direct link to post your review: https://g2.com/write-a-review/redwood-inference (we included in the attached one-pager).

If you post it this week, let us know and Ben will mark it in HS-432109. Thanks again — really appreciate the time.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
